iosDebug.command: xcodebuild -workspace SparklingGo.xcworkspace -scheme SparklingGoInHouse -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=iOS,id=REDACTED_IPHONE_UDID' -derivedDataPath build-device -allowProvisioningUpdates DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=REDACTED_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=15.6 -jobs 4 build

iosRelease.command: xcodebuild -workspace SparklingGo.xcworkspace -scheme SparklingGo -configuration Release -destination 'platform=iOS,id=REDACTED_IPHONE_UDID' -derivedDataPath build-device -allowProvisioningUpdates DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=REDACTED_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=15.6 -jobs 4 build

bindings.command: CONSUMER_ROOT=<probe> CONSUMER_TARBALL=<exact vendor archive> bun run check:consumer:bindings

instrumentation: adb -s REDACTED_PIXEL_SERIAL shell am instrument -w -r -e class com.probe.e2e.LifecycleDeviceTest com.probe.e2e.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner

flow: install exact preserved APK/.app in place
home; open com.probe.e2e; Read lifecycle snapshot
Debug: Unsubscribe B; home/open; snapshot; Subscribe B; home/open; snapshot
Release: Run Secure Store checks; wait for 10/10; Run Crypto native checks; capture PASS
close both sessions; stop owned daemon; uninstall owned XCTest runner only
